entities.why: A carcinoma arising in heterotopic thyroid or salivary tissue, after a primary carcinoma at the usual site is excluded (Hernandez-Prera 2022, PDF p. 2). Thyroid-type cases lie in the midline along the thyroglossal duct and are mostly papillary thyroid carcinoma, at ages 9 to 83 (PDF p. 6): they belong to the thyroid tree. Salivary-type cases lie in neck lymph nodes and are subtyped as salivary carcinomas (PDF p. 7). Their topography and code wait on the registrar (registrar question 5).

conflicts.issue: ICCC-2017 places the carcinoma codes at the pituitary (C75.1) and pineal (C75.3) in XIf10, while pituitary tumours (8270-8281, 8300, and 8158 and 8290 at C75.1) are IIIe1 and the pineal tumours are Group III. This part leaves C75.1 and C75.3 out of its sites and en_histology refers pituitary and pineal tumours to Group 3.
8000/3 at the brain, spinal cord, meninges and craniopharyngeal duct is IIIf, so a tissue-free case at these sites refers to Group 3, not Group 12.
Craniopharyngioma (IIIe2, behaviours 0, 1 and 3), choroid plexus carcinoma (IIIa2) and papillary tumour of the pineal region (IIIe3) are Group III; en_histology and cn_histology refer them.
Paragangliomas of the carotid body, aortic body and retroperitoneum are IVb at every site; en_histology and en_clinical refer them.
Malignant mesothelioma is XIIa5 at every site, and 8000/3 is XIIb at these sites; pe_histology refers mesothelioma and the tissue-free answers refer 8000/3.
Desmoplastic small round cell tumour is IXd11 at every site; pe_histology refers it.
Seromucinous carcinoma is Xd at every site in ICCC-2017; the Group 11 currency check (section 6) lists it under XIf10. The tree refers it to Group 10.

Serous carcinoma is XIf10 at the peritoneum but Xd at the ovary; ICD-O-3.2 ties low-grade and high-grade serous carcinoma to the ovary (Rule H), so the peritoneum is recorded only when the report says the tumour began there.
Hepatocellular carcinoma with no primary named is recorded at the liver by Rule H and is VIIb at every site; cu_histology refers it.

Within Group XI, Rule H moves a carcinoma of unknown primary to the thyroid tree (papillary carcinoma of thyroid, XIb), the nasopharynx tree (Schmincke tumor, XIc), the skin tree (Merkel cell carcinoma, XIe), the breast (infiltrating duct carcinoma, XIf6) or the parathyroid gland (XIf10). The thyroid tree must also take thyroglossal duct carcinoma (data gap 5).
No ICCC-2017 range holds 8158 or 8290 at C70-C72: their XIf10 range leaves out 700-729 and IIIe1 holds them only at C75.1. The picker does not offer them at C70-C72 (registrar question 10).
A lymphoma of the parathyroid gland is Group II; pt_histology refers it.

registrar_questions: Parathyroid carcinoma as an option. Pfister 2022 Table 3 (PDF p. 14) lists parathyroid endocrine tumours and parathyroid adenoma in the paediatric classification without naming carcinoma; ICCR Parathyroid 2025 (PDF p. 5) gives hyperparathyroidism-jaw tumour syndrome (CDC73) a lifetime parathyroid carcinoma risk of about 15%, and Pfister (PDF p. 19) lists that syndrome among paediatric predisposition syndromes. Proposed: Parathyroid carcinoma (8140/3) is an answer on pt_histology. Confirm.

Water-clear cell or oncocytic parathyroid carcinoma. The WHO 5th-edition table gives only 8140/3 (ICCR, PDF p. 9). ICD-O-3.2 holds 8322/3 Water-clear cell adenocarcinoma (C75.0) and 8290/3 Oxyphilic adenocarcinoma (Oncocytic carcinoma). Rule K takes the higher code. Should a report naming water-clear cell or oncocytic parathyroid carcinoma record 8322/3 or 8290/3 (Rule K), or 8140/3 (the WHO table)?

A report that names only 'parafibromin-deficient parathyroid neoplasm' and states no carcinoma, atypical tumour or adenoma. ICD-O-3.2 has no term for it and the diagnosis is strictly histological (Erickson 2022, PDF p. 12). Proposed: not registered until the report states carcinoma. Confirm.

A neck lymph node carcinoma that is EBER positive, or p16 or high-risk HPV positive, with no primary named by the report or clinician. The WHO defines true carcinoma of unknown primary as p16 and EBER negative (Hernandez-Prera 2022, PDF p. 2), and EBER correlates with a nasopharyngeal origin (PDF p. 8). ICD-O Rule H applies only to terms that print a site, and Non-keratinizing squamous cell carcinoma (8072/3) prints none. The tree records C80.9 unless the report or clinician names the organ. Should EBER positivity alone record the nasopharynx (C11.9), and p16 or HPV positivity the oropharynx?

Heterotopia-associated salivary carcinoma in a neck lymph node (Hernandez-Prera 2022, PDF p. 7). Which topography: lymph node (C77.0, which no ICCC-2017 Group XI range holds), head, face or neck (C76.0), or the salivary gland? Which morphology: the salivary type (for example Mucoepidermoid carcinoma 8430/3) or Carcinoma, NOS (8010/3), under which ICD-O-3.2 lists Heterotopia-associated carcinoma?

Carcinoma of unknown primary types. The WHO names squamous cell, undifferentiated and neuroendocrine morphology (Hernandez-Prera 2022, PDF p. 8), but no source reports carcinoma of unknown primary in children. Should Squamous cell carcinoma, NOS (8070/3), Carcinoma, undifferentiated, NOS (8020/3), Neuroendocrine carcinoma, NOS (8246/3) and Adenocarcinoma, NOS (8140/3) be answers on cu_histology, or stay in the picker beside Carcinoma, NOS (8010/3)?

Tissue-free registration with no primary found. Does Visser 2023 Table 4 apply when imaging shows only deposits and a raised chromogranin A or serotonin, recording Neuroendocrine tumor, NOS (8240/3) or Enterochromaffin cell carcinoid (8241/3) at C80.9 with basis 4?

Seromucinous carcinoma (8474/3). The Group 11 currency check (section 6) lists it under XIf10; ICCC-2017 places 8474 in Xd at every site. Confirm the referral to Group 10 and correct the currency check.
Pituitary (C75.1) and pineal (C75.3). ICCC-2017 places carcinoma codes there in XIf10. Confirm that the Group 11 site list leaves both out and refers pituitary and pineal tumours to Group 3.
8158/3 (ACTH-producing tumor) and 8290/3 (Oxyphilic adenocarcinoma) at the brain, spinal cord and meninges fall in no ICCC-2017 range. Proposed: not offered at C70-C72. Confirm.
